capturedWith.scale: BooKoo Mini, through its Decaid plugin

about: One real pour on a DE1Pro with a real scale, captured by hand (scripts/fake-decaid-recorder/capture-real-pour.mjs) and scrubbed (scrub-real-pour.mjs): each socket frame with its time from just before the first espresso frame, through the Shot's store, and the Shot Decaid stored. Its Workflow is the sample data's House espresso but for the profile, dose and yield it was pulled with (fake-decaid/machine.js; docs/cafe/TESTING.md, "The real pour").
timeZone: local, as the tablet stamped its frames

profile.title: Best practice (light roast)
profile.notes: This profile aims to unite the best practices in espresso extraction that we have learned so far with the Decent. It unites Brakel's Londonium, Rao's Blooming and Gagné's Adaptive profiles. Your grind should be coarser for light roasts, aiming for a flow rate around 2.5 ml/s at peak pressure. 18g in, 50g out, in 60 seconds is a typical recipe.   Grind fine enough to keep dripping during preinfusion to around 8g.
profile.author: Decent
